_comment: model=linear: age = round(intercept + sum(category_weights * severity score) + rating_offsets[aliased rating] + kind_offsets[kind] + genre_offsets + numeric terms), clamped to [min_age, max_age], then raised to rating_floor if lower. Fitted to data/labels.json (labelled titles show their label directly; this model scores the rest). Feature set chosen by leave-one-out error; severity weights constrained non-negative. Refit when labels change.
_missing_severity: Score used for a Parents Guide category IMDb has no data for (0=None .. 3=Severe). Such titles are shown as estimates.
